page_title: VEN 2-1 CAG | Venezia v Cagliari 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+3' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
90+1' Francesco Zampano comes off the pitch to be replaced by Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia).
90' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joel Schingtienne (Venezia) replacing Gianluca Busio.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
86' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Razvan Marin.
84' Here is a change. Gaetano Oristanio is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to John Yeboah (Venezia).
84' Substitution. Joel Pohjanpalo makes his way off the pitch and Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) comes on as his replacement.
83' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

83' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Filip Stankovic shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
82' Jay Idzes (Venezia) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
82' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
76' 2 - 1 Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) jumps for a cross and plants a brilliant header into the roof of the net.
73' Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
72' It will be a substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is ready to enter the pitch as Roberto Piccoli walks off.
72' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) replaces Yerry Mina.
71' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
70' Here's the change. Magnus Kofod Andersen leaves the pitch and Domen Crnigoj (Venezia) comes on as a substitute.
67' 2 - 0 Marin Sverko (Venezia) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alen Sherri with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
65' Substitution. Nadir Zortea will be replaced by Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
65' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Gianluca Gaetano is replaced by Razvan Marin (Cagliari).
61' Celebrations are cut short for Venezia as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
61' The Venezia players halt their celebrations as referee Marco Guida makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
61' 2 - 0 GOAL! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Alen Sherri, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:0.

60' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Alen Sherri!
59' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
53' A substitution has been made. Alessandro Deiola is replaced by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
49' Venezia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' A snap shot by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) from the edge of the area flies towards the top right corner, but Alen Sherri produces a good reflex save to thwart him.
46' Jay Idzes (Venezia) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 28:72.
43' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Filip Stankovic.
42' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
40' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
38' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Gaetano Oristanio tees up Francesco Zampano (Venezia) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top left corner and past Alen Sherri.
37' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
35' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
34' None of the Venezia players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
32' Cagliari earn a corner.

32' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the roof of the net, but Filip Stankovic pulls off a decent save to deny him.
30' A cross into the box from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is cleared.
28' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
28' Jay Idzes (Venezia) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece.
26' Cagliari are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
23' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
22' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
22' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia). Corner kick. Venezia will have an opportunity.
20' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
19' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) and Sebastiano Luperto attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
18' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
15' The ball is behind the sideline. Giorgio Altare (Venezia) takes a throw-in.
13' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' The ball is cleared after Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' A lofted cross from Francesco Zampano (Venezia) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
5' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
4' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
Venezia will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Guida.
